;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**At least 27 Afghan soldiers have been killed during a [[Taliban]] attack at a convoy in the [[Alishing District]] of [[Laghman Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan/6%C2%A0afghan-forces-killed-taliban-attack-laghman-mod (Tolo News)]

;Arts and culture
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]; [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on The Walt Disney Company]]
**[[Shanghai Disneyland Park|Shanghai Disneyland]] reopens with new [[social distancing]] rules. [https://amp.theguardian.com/film/2020/may/11/coronavirus-disney-reopens-shanghai-theme-park-with-many-restrictions (''The Guardian'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Socio-economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
**[[Tesla, Inc.]] [[CEO]] [[Elon Musk]] announces he will reopen the [[Tesla Factory]] in [[Fremont, California]], United States, in defiance of an [[Alameda County, California|Alameda County]] shutdown order. [[Governor of California|Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]] voiced his support for the reopening of the factory. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/05/11/cars/elon-musk-tesla-factory-tweet/index.html (CNN)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
***New coronavirus clusters are reported in [[Wuhan]]—where the virus first emerged—and the north-eastern province of [[Jilin]], after confirming its first case since April 3. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-52613138 (BBC News)]
***Wuhan plans to test all 11 million of their residents for the coronavirus. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/after-six-new-cases-wuhan-plans-to-test-all-11-million-residents-for-coronavirus/2020/05/12/9e245722-9411-11ea-87a3-22d324235636_story.html (''Washington Post'')] 
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The death toll from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in the [[United States]] exceeds 80,000. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-usa-casualties/u-s-coronavirus-death-toll-tops-80000-reuters-tally-idUKKBN22N2MX?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
**[[Government of Malaysia|Malaysian authorities]] detains hundreds of [[Pendatang asing|foreign workers]] in a major raid in areas around the [[Kuala Lumpur]] Wholesale Market. It is the second major raid on the country's biggest wholesale [[wet market]] by the authorities amid the [[2020 Malaysia movement control order|movement control order]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/malaysia-detains-hundreds-of-foreign-workers-in-major-raid-on-kl-wholesale-market? (''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Vital Kamerhe]], chief of staff of the [[government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo]], denies all charges of [[embezzling]] more than [[United States dollar|$]]50 million in public funds. Kamerhe, who appeared before a court for two hours wearing prison fatigues and a surgical mask, could face up to 20 years in prison if convicted. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-politics/congo-presidents-chief-of-staff-denies-graft-charges-as-trial-begins-idUSKBN22N2M7?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*Aftermath of the [[Macuto Bay raid]], [[Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[Venezuela]]n opposition leader [[Juan Guaidó]] accepts the resignations of his aides [[JJ Rendón]] and Sergio Vergara, over their roles in "Operation Gideon". Rendón and Vergara admitted signing a contract with [[Jordan Goudreau]]'s Silvercorp USA in October 2019 to help remove [[Nicolás Maduro]] from office, and install Guaidó as [[President of Venezuela|President]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-05-11/guaido-aides-resign-posts-after-botched-invasion-of-venezuela (Bloomberg)]
*[[Lesotho]]'s [[Prime Minister of Lesotho|Prime Minister]] [[Tom Thabane]]'s [[coalition government|coalition]] [[government of Lesotho|government]] collapses in [[parliament of Lesotho|parliament]]. He is due to resign on May 22 amid accusations that he and his wife are involved in his ex-wife's [[murder]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lesotho-politics/lesotho-pm-thabanes-coalition-folds-he-leaves-on-may-22-speaker-idUSKBN22N1FF?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*The [[Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology]] publishes the result of radiocarbon and DNA analysis from the fossils that has been found in the [[Bacho Kiro Cave]], [[Bulgaria]]. The result, showing that the fossils belong to ''[[Homo sapiens]]'' instead of [[Neanderthal]], indicates that modern humans may have arrived in Europe thousands of years earlier than previously thought. [https://www.dw.com/en/bulgarian-fossils-suggest-homo-sapiens-arrived-in-europe-earlier-than-previously-thought/a-53399586 (DW)]

;Sports

**[[2020 Major League Baseball season]]
***[[Major League Baseball]] team owners approve a proposal by Commissioner [[Rob Manfred]] to start the season in early July. It still needs to be approved by the [[Major League Baseball Players Association]]. [https://www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/29162217/owners-approve-mlb-season-proposal-plan-july-start-players-union-preps-weigh-it (ESPN)]
